notes: Four parallel אֲשֶׁר clauses each take their own *who*; the closing waw takes the subordinator *that* the ASV writes for it (rules 14, 55).
אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהֶם רֹעֶה follows rule 43's closing sentence on the relative possessive: *which* on the relative, *have* on לְ, *no* on אַיִן, and the resumptive suffix unrepresented under rule 22.
The article assimilated into כַּ is a real token (rule 12) but the ASV writes no *the* for *as sheep*, so it is unrepresented (rule 29).
